identity.evidence: Engineering identity assumption: the official MaleCNS download page (https://male-cns.janelia.org/download/, checked 2026-09-13) describes the weights file as segment-to-segment connection strengths of the same v1.0 minconf-0.5 release whose per-body annotations and per-neuron aggregate neurotransmitter predictions are the other two files; body_pre/body_post, bodyId and body are all signed int64 body identifiers. The source value audit (evidence/malecns-source-20260913/graph-values-audit.json) found 165,122 status==Traced bodies with unique IDs and 25,563,197 weights rows whose two endpoints are both Traced bodies. This is not a measured biological mapping.
